instruct:
A female voice. Accent: affected upper-class American, drawling and imperious. Mrs. Vivian Pemberton, wealthy widow from Pasadena, room 102; nothing is ever quite right.
Natural, conversational telephone speech, 1950s.
sample_text: Operator, housekeeping. At once, please. This is Mrs. Pemberton in 102. There is a draft in this room. I require another blanket.
